text: Six regular hexagons surround a regular hexagon of side length $1$ as shown. What is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
figure: A central regular hexagon of side 1 has two horizontal sides, so its leftmost and rightmost points are vertices. Six congruent regular hexagons surround it, each sharing one side with it (top, upper-right, lower-right, bottom, lower-left, upper-left). Point A is the vertex where the upper-left and lower-left hexagons meet, directly to the left of the central hexagon's left vertex and joined to it by a shared horizontal edge of length 1. Point B is the vertex shared by the top and upper-right hexagons, and C is the vertex shared by the bottom and lower-right hexagons; B is directly above C. Triangle ABC is drawn: side BC is a vertical segment passing through the central hexagon's right vertex, side AB passes through the central hexagon's upper-left vertex, and side AC passes through its lower-left vertex. Extra segments join B to the central hexagon's upper-right vertex and C to its lower-right vertex.
